title: SCORNED WILDERNESS RAID | Post patch QUICKRUN guide
author: ShootBlood
description:
Jagex recently patched all shortcuts, exploits, and glitches for this raid. This video shows you one of the fastest ways to complete the Scorned Wilderness raid and get to the game's end boss: Kuldra! Hope this helps you complete the raid over and over again in no time.

For a video how to quickly and effectively defeat Kulda (solo), see my channel.
